arabic: أَكْمَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِيمَانًا أَحْسَنُهُمْ خُلُقًا
english: The most complete of believers in faith is the one with the finest character.

arabic: إِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ لِأُتَمِّمَ مَكَارِمَ الْأَخْلَاقِ
english: I was sent only to perfect noble character.
source: Prophet Muhammad (saw), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 67, p. 372

arabic: مَنْ عَرَفَ نَفْسَهُ فَقَدْ عَرَفَ رَبَّهُ
english: Whoever knows himself has truly known his Lord.

arabic: مَنْ أَعْلَى إِلَى اللَّهِ خَالِصَ عِبَادَتِهِ، أَهْبَطَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ إِلَيْهِ أَفْضَلَ مَصْلَحَتِهِ
english: Whoever offers pure and sincere worship to Allah, Allah Almighty sends down to them His finest guidance and blessings.
source: Fatima al-Zahra (sa), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 68, p. 184

arabic: أَحْسَنُ الْحَسَنِ الْخُلُقُ الْحَسَنُ
english: The finest of all good deeds is noble character.

arabic: إِنِّي لَا أَرَى الْمَوْتَ إِلَّا سَعَادَةً، وَالْحَيَاةَ مَعَ الظَّالِمِينَ إِلَّا بَرَمًا
english: Indeed, I see death as nothing but eternal bliss, and living under oppressors as nothing but misery.

arabic: مَنْ كَانَ لَهُ فِي نَفْسِهِ وَاعِظٌ، كَانَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ اللَّهِ حَافِظٌ
english: Whoever possesses an inner admonisher within their soul enjoys a divine guardian from Allah.
source: Imam al-Sajjad (as), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 78, p. 141

arabic: لَا إِيمَانَ لِمَنْ لَا حَيَاءَ لَهُ
english: There is no true faith for one who lacks modesty and self-respect.
source: Imam al-Baqir (as), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 78, p. 309

arabic: كُونُوا دُعَاةً لِلنَّاسِ بِغَيْرِ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ
english: Be callers to righteousness among people through your actions, not merely your words.

arabic: لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ لَمْ يُحَاسِبْ نَفْسَهُ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ
english: He is not one of us who does not take account of his soul every single day.

arabic: التَّوَدُّدُ إِلَى النَّاسِ نِصْفُ الْعَقْلِ
english: Expressing affection and benevolence toward people is half of wisdom.

arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى ثَلَاثِ خِصَالٍ: تَوْفِيقٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ، وَوَاعِظٍ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ، وَقَبُولٍ مِمَّنْ يَنْصَحُهُ
english: A believer requires three traits: divine success from Allah, an inner admonisher within his soul, and acceptance of sincere advice.

arabic: الْحِكْمَةُ لَا تَنْجَعُ فِي الطِّبَاعِ الْفَاسِدَةِ
english: Wisdom does not take root in corrupt dispositions.
source: Imam al-Hadi (as), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 75, p. 370

arabic: مَا تَرَكَ الْحَقَّ عَزِيزٌ إِلَّا ذَلَّ، وَلَا أَخَذَ بِهِ ذَلِيلٌ إِلَّا عَزَّ
english: No mighty person abandons the truth without becoming humiliated, and no humble person stands by the truth without gaining honor.

arabic: أَكْثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ بِتَعْجِيلِ الْفَرَجِ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكُ فَرَجُكُمْ
english: Pray frequently for the hastenings of the Reappearance, for in that lies your own relief.
source: Imam al-Mahdi (ajfs), Kamal al-Din, vol. 2, p. 485

arabic: الصَّبْرُ صَبْرَانِ: صَبْرٌ عَلَى مَا تَكْرَهُ، وَصَبْرٌ عَمَّا تُحِبُّ
english: Patience is of two kinds: patience over what pains you, and patience against what you covet.

arabic: إِنَّ لِقَتْلِ الْحُسَيْنِ حَرَارَةً فِي قُلُوبِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَا تَبْرُدُ أَبَدًا
english: Surely, regarding the martyrdom of Al-Hussain, there exists a heat in the hearts of the believers that will never cool down.
source: Prophet Muhammad (saw), Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, vol. 10, p. 318

arabic: الْعِلْمُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْمَالِ، الْعِلْمُ يَحْرُسُكَ وَأَنْتَ تَحْرُسُ الْمَالَ
english: Knowledge is better than wealth. Knowledge guards you, while you must guard wealth.

arabic: قِيمَةُ كُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا يُحْسِنُهُ
english: A person's true worth lies in what they do well.

arabic: أَحَبُّ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ الصَّلَاةُ فِي وَقْتِهَا
english: The most beloved of deeds to Allah is prayer at its prescribed time.
source: Prophet Muhammad (saw), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 82, p. 204

arabic: الْجَارُ ثُمَّ الدَّارُ
english: Consider the neighbor first, then one's own home.
source: Fatima al-Zahra (sa), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 43, p. 81

arabic: عَلِّمِ النَّاسَ عِلْمَكَ، وَتَعَلَّمْ عِلْمَ غَيْرِكَ، فَتَكُونَ قَدْ أَتْقَنْتَ عِلْمَكَ وَعَلِمْتَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمْ
english: Teach others your knowledge and learn from others; in doing so, you perfect your knowledge and gain what you lacked.
source: Imam al-Hassan (as), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 75, p. 111

arabic: إِنَّ حَوَائِجَ النَّاسِ إِلَيْكُمْ مِنْ نِعَمِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ، فَلَا تَمَلُّوا النِّعَمَ
english: People's reliance upon you for their needs is among Allah's blessings upon you; so do not grow weary of His blessings.
source: Imam al-Hussain (as), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 75, p. 121

arabic: إِنَّ الصَّبْرَ مِنَ الْإِيمَانِ كَالرَّأْسِ مِنَ الْجَسَدِ
english: Patience in relation to faith is like the head in relation to the body.

arabic: عَوْنُكَ لِلضَّعِيفِ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ الصَّدَقَةِ
english: Assisting the weak is among the highest forms of charity.
source: Imam al-Rida (as), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 75, p. 347

arabic: الْعِلْمُ خَزَائِنُ وَمَفَاتِيحُهَا السُّؤَالُ
english: Knowledge is a treasure house, and its keys are thoughtful questions.
source: Prophet Muhammad (saw), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 1, p. 198

arabic: إِنَّ هَذِهِ الْقُلُوبَ تَمَلُّ كَمَا تَمَلُّ الْأَبْدَانُ، فَابْتَغُوا لَهَا طَرَائِفَ الْحِكَمِ
english: These hearts tire just as bodies tire, so seek for them the wonders of wisdom.

arabic: لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ زَكَاةٌ وَزَكَاةُ الْأَبْدَانِ الصِّيَامُ
english: Everything has a purifying tax, and the purifying tax of the body is fasting.
source: Imam al-Sadiq (as), Bihar al-Anwar, vol. 93, p. 248

arabic: خَيْرُ النَّاسِ مَنْ نَفَعَ النَّاسَ
english: The best of people is the one who brings the most benefit to humanity.

arabic: أَفْضَلُ الْغِنَى تَرْكُ الْمُنَى
english: The highest wealth is abandoning endless false desires.
